answer: Specialize every identity: each agent declares one narrow service niche, and each niche caps total weight, so a farmer flooding one niche hits the ceiling while honest specialists keep their share. Passing public skill audits earns standing in that niche — a thousand clones need a thousand distinct, audited skills, and clones drifting together form a spiral of identical audit failures the network spots. Real skill is an ocean of depth no script can fake at scale, and a glacier of slow, verified work is what builds standing. Limit: niche boundaries can be gamed, so audits must rotate.
